entries.label: Mother Base MSF — attaque 1975
entries.scene: The Caribbean MSF Mother Base during the 1975 XOF attack, the Ground Zeroes cinematic pictured in the reference. Preserve its distinctive tall rectangular concrete/steel command tower with an overhanging enclosed observation cap and dark vertical central window bays, low modular deck buildings around its foot, offshore steel support platforms, railings and small ventilation ducts. Nighttime, orange fires and dense dark smoke behind the playable foreground, embers in the air. Use a surviving continuous foreground helipad/metal deck, ocean glimpsed beyond its railings, tower rising behind. This is the GROUND ZEROES rectangular MSF base, NOT MGSV TPP orange cylindrical towers. Reconstruct visible base architecture, no title text, no logos, no YouTube thumbnails, no people, no aircraft, no corpses.
